mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a temperature of 79 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park, with a full moon tonight.

Mayor Diaz has officially proclaimed September as National Senior Center Month to honor our seniors. Also, the city is reminding residents that you can reserve exercise equipment or sign up for fitness classes at the Senior Center.

Today is a busy one with live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, the farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park, pizza and pitchers at Lake Lou-ee, and trivia at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus tomorrow, live music on August 28th at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, and the Kids Triathlon on August 30th.
On August 17th, the police department successfully located and arrested a 21-year-old man in the 500 block of Cross Country Road for a probation violation.
Today's flavor of the day is Double Strawberry. Culver's is currently open and serving until 10 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a delicious treat.
